reviewNotes: Seven final object strings covering wool, a live worm, yams, and yam seeds were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover material description, creature wording, crop terminology, culinary meaning, crop timing, object gender, and source fidelity; both found no remaining objective issue.

Yam_Description.source: A starchy tuber with a lot of culinary versatility.
Yam_Description.translation: Un tubercul bogat în amidon, cu numeroase întrebuințări culinare.

YamSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the fall. Takes 10 days to mature.
YamSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le toamna. Ajung la maturitate în 10 zile.
